jsonDiff.title: JSON Structural Diff
jsonDiff.description: Compare API payloads by structure and locate added, removed, or changed values.
jsonDiff.supportedNote: Object key order is ignored; types and array order are preserved. Added or removed subtrees count as one change. Each input: 1 MiB, 20,000 nodes, 64 nesting levels. Maximum: 500 changes, 4,096 characters per path, 4 MiB per report. Numbers use JavaScript precision; integers must be safe integers. JSON.parse rules apply, including the last value winning for duplicate keys. Numbers that round or underflow are rejected; use strings for exact large numbers or high-precision decimals.
jsonDiff.emptyState: Paste JSON on both sides to compare. Objects, arrays, and scalar values are supported.
jsonDiff.equal: The JSON values are structurally equal.
jsonDiff.reportNote: Copy and download include the complete report. Filtering only changes the visible results.

errors.unsupportedNumber: {{side}} contains a number that cannot be preserved with JavaScript precision (non-finite, an unsafe integer, rounding or underflow). Use a string to preserve the exact value.
errors.tooManyChanges: The comparison exceeds {{changes}} changes. Compare a smaller part of the payload; no partial report is shown.
errors.pathTooLong: A changed JSON path exceeds {{path}} characters. Shorten the property names or compare a smaller subtree.
errors.reportTooLarge: The JSON report exceeds 4 MiB. Compare a smaller part of the payload; no partial report is shown.

about.title: About
about.description: A browser toolbox for SMS encoding, API payload inspection and POS troubleshooting, with reusable local Pipelines.
about.offlineDesc: After a successful online visit and service-worker caching, tools can work offline. First load and updates need a connection; offline availability depends on browser storage.
about.privacyDesc: Tool inputs are processed in your browser without uploads. The host receives ordinary site requests. Preferences and saved Pipelines use local storage. Sharing a Pipeline puts its input and settings in the URL fragment: anyone with the link can read them. External links leave the app when clicked. No app analytics or tracking cookies.
about.securityDesc: Supported modern cryptographic operations use the Web Crypto API. MD5 and CRC are intended for legacy compatibility and checksums. Verify outputs against your application protocol.
about.openSourceDesc: Dev Toolbox is open source. Contributions, bug reports, and feature requests are welcome.
